about: Measured model error shown with every simulation result (owner decision 2026-11-09). Numbers only, from the Janus PK-1 calibration analysis of 2026-11-09 and the Janus research note docs/research/httk-pop-older-adult-exposure.md; no label text. Expert review has not yet been done.

httk_half_life.compared: httk calc_half_life (package defaults) against measured human half-life
httk_half_life.dataset: Obach, Lombardo & Waters 2008, human intravenous pharmacokinetics (doi:10.1124/dmd.108.020479), as TDC Half_Life_Obach, Harvard Dataverse datafile 4266799

conformal.method: split conformal on absolute log10 residuals, finite-sample corrected quantile, one global quantile; Bemis-Murcko scaffold split 60/20/20, seed 0

httk_concentrations.note: steady-state concentrations and their population bands are not validated against measured data
